justification: X.509 parsing of the DER chain of a live TLS handshake for tls_inspect (P275 cond 6: certificates are parsed with the optional 'cryptography' extra). Optional: without it tls_inspect parses the DER itself with a bounded standard-library reader (same facts) and falls back to getpeercert() for chains that verify.
notes: Batch p9-G03-3. Used unmodified; never required (tls_inspect does not list it in requires_packages).
